data.one_liner: Mobile-first Dart library for building stateful, tool-using AI agents with LLM and MCP support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a full agentic loop supporting tool usage, state persistence, multi-turn memory, context compression, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) connections. It coordinates mainstream LLM providers entirely in Dart without requiring a backend.
use_when: You want to build stateful AI agents directly inside a Flutter mobile, web, or desktop application.
You need multi-provider LLM support with tool calling and context compression.
You want to connect local or remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
avoid_when: You only need a simple stateless text completion without tool calling or agentic loops.
You prefer running agent orchestration entirely on a Python or Node.js backend rather than on-device.
strengths: Runs natively on all six Dart/Flutter platforms including Web and WASM.
Unified LLMClient interface supporting OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic Claude, Bedrock, and various compatible APIs.
Comprehensive feature set including tool execution, sub-agents, planning, MCP, and agent evals.
weaknesses: Requires proper API key management on client platforms like the web.
File system storage features require specific platform adapters when deployed on the web.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and configure your provider API keys or local base URLs.
